reviews.text: Very good service, more parking spaces are needed

They brought in a dog that had been hit by a car, and besides charging for everything, they couldn't even diagnose it or take x-rays to see where it was injured. TERRIBLE SERVICE! They're great at taking your money!! I don't recommend them at all!!
They took great care of my dog ​​who had a puppy, treating her with humanity and professionalism. I highly recommend them.

If you can, avoid coming here. I try to rescue dogs with what little I have, and I brought in a dog in the middle of the night at 3 a.m. that had been hit by a car in the afternoon and had been lying there for hours. They charged me $13,000 for just two days of anesthesia and a urinary catheter. I have to take the dog to a neurologist because they don't offer that service here, even for the price they charge. And getting a report is a joke; they tell you absolutely nothing. With that money, I could have helped many more stray dogs.

I work with dogs and treat several dogs in this area, so I've come here many times with different pets. I've even brought my clients' cats.

If you make an appointment and arrive on time, they'll take at least half an hour after the scheduled time to see your pet. If you arrive late (even if you're still within their own estimated wait time), they refuse to see you and tell you they have a 10-minute grace period.

If you arrive without an appointment for a general consultation, the wait time ranges from half an hour to all day. They don't have any grace period for seeing pets and their owners.

For what they charge, they should at least respect their own schedules.
Quality and warmth in the care provided by Dr. Andrea.
Dr. Aytzee was very kind, attentive, and professional. I had an ophthalmology appointment, and within a week (when her check-up was), my dog ​​had already shown improvement.

They charged me nearly $16,000 MXN for just over a day of hospitalization, demanded disproportionate supplies (like an excessive number of syringes), and ordered multiple tests even though the diagnosis and risk were clear. They argued that the pets needed to be hospitalized for more than five days and gave a 90% probability of mortality for one of the animals, offering to keep it under treatment.

After requesting a voluntary discharge to transfer them to another clinic, two (external) veterinarians confirmed that one of the animals had suffered a broken leg while receiving an IV. Sadly, this patient died.

The second animal, which also had a 90% mortality prognosis at the clinic, survived after being treated externally by other professionals.
I believe they profit from the love we have for our pets, playing with their chances of survival and exploiting their pain for financial gain.

We were worried about a possible emergency. They professionally and kindly reassured us and showed us that our cat was not in any danger. They were very patient and answered all our questions. We were very satisfied with the service and the prices. We definitely recommend them.

My time at Animal Home has been an emotional rollercoaster due to the different situations I've experienced with my girls, but they've saved them from death twice already. They operated on my baby after she was hit by a car and she recovered. Recently, she had her cancer treatment with Dr. Jorge Morales and I'm so grateful for the way we've been treated.

The vet wanted us to pay for four tests for my dog, who came in vomiting. He said she was about to develop a fever when she didn't even have one.
He was incredibly alarmist, saying my dog ​​could die and that she most likely had parvovirus. He told us we had to hospitalize her without giving us an accurate diagnosis.
In the end, we went to another vet, and they told us she needed deworming and prescribed a wet diet.
It's awful that they take advantage of this to make extra money.

The service has changed a lot compared to what it was several years ago. My beagle, who was scratching excessively, had surgery based on the diagnosis, but he didn't improve. The last thing they said was that they couldn't do anything and that we should take him to an emergency dermatologist (somewhere else, even though they have one there too). Isn't this supposed to be an emergency hospital? We already took him, and he's improved, but they confirmed that everything done at the hospital was misdiagnosed, and one of the medications they prescribed there actually harmed him.

I've been taking my dog ​​to this hospital for two years. They've sent us to countless specialists. We already had him operated on for ear surgery because that's what they told us he needed, but my dog ​​is still the same or even worse. At the last appointment, they told us they don't know what's wrong with him and that, for "ethical" reasons, they can't prescribe anything. My dog's condition persists, and it's now more chronic.
They just made us waste money and, above all, time that we could have used to go to another doctor who would actually prescribe something that would help him. Don't trust the diagnoses of the doctors at this hospital.

I started going to Dr. Aytze's ophthalmology clinic for my cat Roca, and I loved the service and the doctor's attention. Roca is almost fully recovered :) and everyone at reception is very friendly. Excellent service.
We have two dogs at home, and whenever they've had a medical issue, we come here and leave feeling reassured. Whether it's for minor things or major surgeries, it's always been an excellent service.

We've visited several times in the last year, and the care from all the veterinarians has been excellent and they've been very kind. The services we've needed include sterilization, dental cleaning, laboratory tests, physical therapy, and consultations—all very good service.

Thank you.
We had my dog ​​euthanized due to her critical condition. The veterinarians were incredibly empathetic, respectful, and compassionate throughout the entire process. Thank you so much, Candy 🕊️🦴 …

Dr. Camacho's care was excellent, but the reception and customer service were not. My dog ​​was going to have surgery there, but the very poor service at reception and follow-up made me decide against it and look for another place for my child's surgery. What a shame.
The girls at reception always treat me very well.

My dog ​​Nina received excellent care. She first came in for a consultation because she was vomiting and generally unwell. The diagnostic methods they used (x-rays and ultrasound) seemed appropriate. All the doctors, including Dr. Angelica Martínez Francisco and Pamela Cardoso, were very kind and empathetic. They demonstrated a strong command of their knowledge, which made me feel confident that my dog ​​would receive the best possible care. Later, she underwent a spaying procedure, and so far (7 days later), everything has progressed perfectly. They have answered all my questions.
Very good service
I've been there several times and generally everything has been fine. The last time I went for my kitten, he had cystitis and Dr. Abril Soria was very attentive, excellent treatment on her part
Great service!

Overall, I consider their services to be of good quality, as well as the patience and attention of all the staff. There's just a slight delay in scheduled appointment times. My Lucky (Beagle) has already had two surgeries at their facilities, and so far, everything has been fine. May God continue to give the veterinarians the intelligence, training, and patience to bring relief to our loved ones.

The care they gave my little Lua was very good; one of the things I loved about Animal
home is that they have all the infrastructure for pet care.

Overall, very good. The doctor who treated us was Stephanie Gonzalez; she was super professional, empathetic, and kind. We recommend you ask for her when you go. As an added tip, ask for a quote of the expenses you'll incur so you don't get any surprises. It's a reliable hospital, depending on the doctor who treats you.

It's an excellent option for emergencies. Although the nighttime consultation is very expensive, it's worth it. I took my dog ​​there at night; it was the only clinic open at that hour. Even though it's far from my house, I took him. He improved immediately; they ran tests, prescribed treatment, and now he's much better. The veterinarians who treated us were very kind and explained everything to me, and the reception service is efficient and punctual.
Excellent, wonderful service, many specialists, very clean and very experienced

Excellent veterinary hospital, top-notch care. They literally saved my dog's life. He had a foreign object in his digestive tract, and I arrived with a misdiagnosis. They identified the problem very quickly, performed the procedure, and in three days, my dog ​​was back home and is now as good as new.
It's expensive, but the care and service are worth it.
Excellent service, very good attention both at reception and from the doctor. My dog ​​responded very well to the treatment and they followed up with him. Thank you very much, highly recommended.
Excellent service, I highly recommend them. The diagnostic response is immediate, although the cost is high. They provide accurate diagnoses for my pets. Specialists.

It's a very good hospital; I've been there before for emergencies, and they do indeed receive you regardless of the time or without prior notice. The doctors are very warm and dedicated in their treatment of both patients and their guardians.
Excellent service!

DO NOT GO HERE! Sadly, I lost two of my most beloved pets due to medical negligence. I paid $5,000 just to admit my pets, plus daily costs that add up to about another $5,000 a day for doing absolutely nothing, since they leave the pets unattended. They claim to run tests but never provide the results. Their prices are outrageous, like $70 pesos for a single disposable diaper, and they charge you based on how often your pet uses them, though they never justify the expenses. In short, if you don't want to lose your loved ones, don't go here. 👎🏻
Good service from the staff and veterinarians, but high costs.
Friendly and professional attitude
Excellent service! They have all the necessary equipment to care for pets!
In both routine and emergency consultations, I have had a good experience to date; the veterinarians explain things well, answer questions, and perform very thorough examinations.

Excellent veterinary hospital, great service.
Dr. Andrea is the best; we've been going to her for years and always get the best results.

The treatment my pets have received has been excellent. Four of my four-legged friends are currently receiving their checkups at this hospital, and they've always been treated very well in the various specialties they've visited. I'm very grateful.
I take my 13-year-old cocker spaniel to ophthalmology to treat his cataracts, and the care and treatment have always been excellent.

Excellent ophthalmology service. My sincere appreciation to Dr. Aytzee Piñón for her professionalism and warmth. If your dog has an eye problem, Dr. Piñón at Animal Home is the best choice for their recovery.

I've been to the vet many times, and the treatment has always been incredible for me and my dogs. They've taken care of them like no one else and have always been attentive. They've had their vaccinations, hospitalizations, and surgical procedures, and they've all been fine.
They took great care of my dog; the doctor explained his follow-up care very well, and he did very well.

Perfect service, they always provide complete and specific information, and they always care about the animals. Every time we go for a consultation, they ask how Lemmy is doing and if we need anything else. Dr. Jorge is always attentive to Lemmy.
The staff is very friendly, my dog ​​is doing very well with the treatment the ophthalmologist prescribed.

Don't take your pets there, they're THIEVES!!! I'm not even sure they're veterinarians. I took my dog ​​there and they returned him in worse condition than when he arrived. They order unnecessary tests and want to perform surgeries that have nothing to do with the main problem. Their diagnoses sound absurd, and then they block you because they have no way to defend their ignorance. Don't take your pets there, they're inept, liars, and thieves!!!
They did tests on my cat and refused to show them to me (obviously I paid for them) because the cloud is deleted every 24 hours.
Good service but the prices are too expensive

I arrived at about 5 am to attend to an EMERGENCY with my Pomeranian, who was very sick and the doctor who opened the door told us that her waiting time was 2 hours and that it was best if we looked for another hospital and that she didn't know of any we could go to and she closed the door on us.
Excellent service

HORRID PLACE, the worst place I've ever been to, zero empathy. I took my puppy there with a fever, and the doctor, without even examining him, assured us he wouldn't make it through the night. He emphasized this several times. Not even an hour had passed when they called to say he had died. We went to pick up his body, and his teeth were broken. We don't know exactly what they did to him. After that, they demanded more money while leaving us waiting with his little body for over 10 minutes in the waiting room in front of everyone.

Do not take your pets to that place under any circumstances. My friend took her puppy there just for a fever, and they returned it to her dead with its teeth destroyed. I don't know what they did to it, but the way they handed it over was incredibly cruel, and they made her wait in the waiting room with her dog's body for a very long time.

Terrible service. We took our rescued dog in, and they gave us the worst possible diagnosis. They said he was very ill and wanted to run more tests, including a CT scan, and that he needed to be transferred to another neurological hospital. They wanted to perform unnecessary tests just to charge more money. He was there for three days, the bill was outrageous, and they didn't even give us a clear diagnosis. Fortunately, we took him to another vet, and now our dog is strong and healthy without needing so many tests. This hospital is unethical. I absolutely do not recommend it.

They do not justify the charges in the hospitalization bill. ‼️
Don't waste your money here. ‼️‼️‼️

I took my dog ​​to the vet, and they told me it was best to admit her since she arrived in a "state of shock" due to liver complications and excess ammonia.

My little one had no appetite even before the hospitalization. They charged me for a can of food that I had consented to being given via nasal tube, and then they charged me for kibble. I asked for justification for this charge and who authorized it, and they told me that by signing the contract, I gave them my trust, which is obviously based on evidence. They charged me for ultrasounds that they could never show me because the cloud data is deleted every 24 hours. And that time hadn't even passed! They left me waiting for 30 minutes to see if they could show me the ultrasound, AND IT NEVER HAPPENED. BECAUSE OBVIOUSLY THEY DIDN'T DO IT. ‼️‼️‼️

The whole administration process is a mess, because they haven't even answered me since yesterday regarding a test I authorized immediately because, according to the doctor, it was a top emergency, and to this day they haven't responded and I still don't have my results.

Clearly, my dog ​​is my priority right now! But rest assured that I will be filing a complaint with PROFECO (the Mexican consumer protection agency). It's unacceptable that, being a paid service, they can't provide proof of what they're charging.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND THEM.

Don't go there, it's a waste of time and money. The doctors are trained to "squeeze money out of you" and they'll put up a thousand obstacles for everything. My 13-year-old dog needed his joint medication, and they refused to give it to me even though I had already paid for it. They told me to come back for the next dose. They made up a story that I had to go to a consultation and pay 700, then to the orthopedist and pay 1,500, and then they would see if they would give it to him. It was just an injection they themselves prescribed. In short, they're thieves. I went to another hospital, and they gave it to him without any problem. He's doing very well now.

I took my puppy to the emergency vet, and he was terrible. He just wanted to rip us off. He didn't inspire any confidence that he was going to try hard. He just told me he looked bad and that he probably wouldn't survive. After hearing that, I said I at least wanted to see him, and he gave me a dirty look and said it wasn't allowed. I had to get aggressive to get them to let me see him. Unfortunately, that was the last time I saw him alive. An hour and a half later, they called to tell me my puppy had died.

My last experience was the worst. They've hired young doctors with very little experience. They did an X-ray of my overweight beagle's spine, took her to the vet, and when he brought her back, she had a terrible leg injury. He was beyond upset. I told him what they had done to her, and she came back limping. He still claims it wasn't them, that she was already like that—a lie. I argued with him and escalated the issue to his supervisor. I told them to take responsibility. He examined her and found a tear in her knee joint. They did it themselves, that inexperienced doctor. They told me she needed to be seen by an orthopedist and that I should schedule a consultation. I told him they would cover the costs. He said I had to go to the appointment first, and then it would depend on what the specialist said. I took her there because she was overweight, and it turned out she had a torn kneecap. I've always taken my dogs there, and this has never happened before because they were treated by experienced people, not inexperienced youngsters. Be very careful when you are taken to a study, especially if you are assigned a young doctor, as they do not have the experience of those who have been there for years.
Excellent service and attention
They tell you one price, then they tell you another and try to charge you more.
Terrible place, they are negligent and completely unprepared, they only care about money and don't care about the pets' well-being ):

The care my pet receives is incredible; the entire team of doctors and receptionists are so kind and empathetic. It gives you peace of mind to bring your beloved companions there. My deepest gratitude to Dr. Jorge Morales, Dr. Armando Morgan, and all the staff who helped my dog ​​with her mouth tumor ❤️

Sadly, my experience at this clinic was very negative. It's incredibly disappointing to see how they operate; there's no empathy or genuine love for the animals. It all feels like a cold transaction where the only thing that matters is making money. They profit without remorse and don't care about the suffering of their patients. Look for a place where they truly care about the lives and well-being of your pets, because they don't here.

They were very professional; they treated my dog ​​for a hematoma on his ear and kept me informed every step of the way. They kept me updated on his progress, and even after he was discharged, I received a follow-up call to check on him. It's important to know that it's not cheap, but the care is worth it.
Excellent service, I was hesitant to attend but I don't regret it.

I would give zero stars, but to give my opinion, you have to rate it at least once.

My experience was negative. They claim to have several specialties, including oncology, which I highly doubt. They asked me to pay in cash (because that doctor only accepts cash). They asked me to have some tests done to verify the diagnosis I had from UNAM (National Autonomous University of Mexico). If you want your results sooner, they charge almost double the price. I've never experienced anything like this. They didn't deliver the test results on the agreed-upon date, and when I called, they had no record of my dog ​​or the test. They said they would call back in five minutes, but nothing. The next day, I called again, and they told me to schedule an appointment with the oncologist to get the test results. Why should I pay for another appointment just to get test results? Anywhere else, they send them to you and the doctor by email. I emailed the specialist my dog's entire medical history and told him I accepted the quote for the surgery and chemotherapy. He never replied, nor did they answer when I called the hospital to request a surgery date. They said they would consult with the oncologist and call me back, but they just wasted my time and money. I didn't receive the necessary care during a critical time.

If you love your pets, look for other options that are professional and have kind and compassionate staff.

If you love your dogs, don't go to this place; you'll be wasting valuable time.

The place is located in a residential area with heavy traffic. It looks like a converted house, and the spaces are very small. There's no parking, and most importantly, there's no professional staff.
Always quality
I am so happy with the care I received from Dr. Abril Soria. Besides being very polite, she is excellent, knows her work well, and explains things clearly. Thank you, Doctor! ❤️
It's a bit pricey, but the service is excellent.

Even though one must accept the loss of a pet due to a complicated diagnosis, it's impossible not to notice the lack of timely and humane follow-up care in some specialized veterinary "hospitals."

Unfortunately, my experience at Animal Home was very disappointing.

On May 8th, I brought my kitten Oso in critical condition, and even though it was an emergency, he waited approximately 25 minutes to be seen.

The ultrasound performed that same night already showed significant inflammation; however, the pancreatic lipase test, key to confirming pancreatitis, wasn't performed until May 9th at 5:38 pm, practically minutes before he left. With critical patients, time matters.

They also charged me for supplies like an Elizabethan collar, canned food, and diapers, even though Oso was almost unconscious. His cage didn't even have a padded base, just the metal bars. Furthermore, they charged me approximately $2,200 for a PCR test, the results of which were never provided.

They didn't provide the full names of the veterinarians in charge, communication was poor, and while we were making payments (almost $16,000 for two days of care), we lost the opportunity to be with Oso in his final moments.

The most unbelievable thing happened afterward: on May 23, I received a message from the hospital informing me that they wanted to call me to give me an update on Oso's condition, when in fact he had already passed away and had been euthanized on May 9 at that same hospital. When I informed them of the error, I didn't even receive an apology.

Beyond the medical outcome, what was truly deplorable was the lack of follow-up, communication, empathy, and internal controls.
Excellent care, professional and empathetic doctors; they are a great option for emergencies and regular checkups. Always attentive and very humane.
Excellent hospital for our pets, high-quality specialized service, answers all your questions, and provides sensitive and kind treatment for my dog.
A reputable hospital with professionals who care for your pets.
The best veterinary hospital for my pets. Very dedicated and professional doctors.

My dog ​​had an emergency a few weeks ago, very early on a Saturday, in the southern part of Mexico City. HVAH Coapa is one of the few veterinary clinics open early. We received excellent care and, above all, follow-up. I thank the entire team for their professionalism.
They treat the dogs wonderfully!! Highly recommended.
The wait was a bit long. But the service was excellent. Prices were reasonable.

If you have the chance to go, don't take it at all. Run if you love your pets. I don't know how this pseudo-hospital/clinic is still open and hasn't been shut down. The people there are so incompetent they don't even understand human behavior. They mistreat pets, invent illnesses, and practically force them to continue treatments just to make money.
Do not go to this clinic; they are completely unprofessional. Far from providing reassurance in treatments or follow-up care for pets, they are inhumane, and their staff is deplorable.
Terrible service. They refused to treat my dog, who was very ill. Don't go there!!! Dangerous
Good service and a wide range of tools and equipment for animal care

Excellent consultation, I loved it, very clear and thorough.
Dr. Abril Sotia

Everything has been great. We've come here for emergencies or for tests because other places that aren't hospitals don't have the necessary equipment.

Every time we've brought our cat in, she's been treated with care and attention during her examination. Pamela has been incredibly affectionate with our cat every time she's seen her. Now, Dr. Kaleb is monitoring her treatment and has also been excellent in his examinations and care, very gentle.

On another occasion, Dr. Angelica treated us, and we also had a very good experience with her.

So far, we've had a positive experience.

As owners, we've also received respectful and professional treatment.

Thank you.
It's totally worth it and reliable.

Excellent Hospital
I took my kitten there when I found her abandoned; she was just two weeks old. They treated her very well. She was hospitalized for five days, given oxygen, and received nebulizer treatments for her lungs. We went back today, and the treatment was just as good. ❤️❤️❤️❤️
It's a private hospital, so obviously the prices reflect the quality of care.
Personally, it's worth every penny.
Excellent service, everything was great, they took excellent care of my kittens, and everyone was very friendly 🫶🏻 …
Very friendly and professional. The medical service is fast, warm, and attentive.
A fantastic place. A bit pricey, but totally worth it. I've been bringing my pets there for checkups and surgery three times for years. They've never let me down. Great hospital.
Excellent hospital.
Very good hospital, they always treat us very well, they take the time to thoroughly examine my dog ​​and the prices are fair.
Very kind and attentive, I leave satisfied with the professional work of the doctors and hospital staff
Excellent care for pets, excellent facilities and equipment.
The care is excellent; they have extensive experience, and the veterinarians provide thorough information about the treatment and your dog's condition. The downside is the high prices.
Very friendly and excellent service
Excellent care and work from the doctors, both at this appointment and the previous one. They saved my little girl's life. Thank you so much.
Don't go there, they have no empathy. They didn't give my dog ​​anything when she needed urgent help; they gave her one diagnosis instead of another.
They serve you very quickly and are very friendly.
Excellent service, highly qualified doctors
Excellent veterinary clinic with great space for animals and very good customer service
The service is good; I brought my dog ​​in for an emergency and they were very helpful. It's not a cheap place, but it's worth it.
We have been coming here with our pets for 20 years and have always received excellent care and follow-up; they are very professional and loving with them.
Excellent service, everyone is always very attentive, and the doctors are top-notch. I've brought my two little ones here, and they've received the best care.
Excellent hospital. Dr. Andrea is one of the best I've ever known and our primary veterinarian. We go there for any emergency. The prices are a bit high, but our dogs are worth it.
Terrible place! If you truly love your pets, don't take them to this hospital with such awful service! They just try to squeeze every last penny out of you!
Excellent service in all areas. Caring and friendly treatment of all pets and owners, 100% recommended.
Excellent service overall, with experienced and attentive doctors, and the hospital has all the necessary medical equipment to provide good care. Highly recommended!
The care provided was excellent; they perform all kinds of tests to rule out diseases or viruses, and they provide excellent information and answer any questions you may have about care.
I do not recommend ophthalmologist Aitze Piñon because she does not provide proper follow-up for your pet after the operation; she gives you appointments but then loses interest.

The service has declined lately, both by phone and in person at reception. I absolutely do not recommend the so-called ophthalmologist Aitze Piñon; she's terrible. My dog ​​lost an eye due to her negligence.
Dr. Aytzeé is amazing! She always takes care of everything a specialist veterinary ophthalmologist needs. Dr. Iker has achieved a very high level of quality at his hospital!

8000 for a prophylaxis, for God's sake!! But as they say, the fault lies not with the Indian, but with the one who makes him a friend!!! If you have money to burn, go there, they'll surely take that extra bit from you; if you're short on cash, don't even bother.

The worst veterinary hospital I've ever been to.

I live very close by, so in emergencies I've had no other option but to take my pets here. The service is rude and overbearing, especially the receptionist. They make you wait for hours for updates or reports. They don't let you see your pet in an emergency, and they only give you reports the next day. The doctors want to do unnecessary tests and studies to get more money out of you, and they charge three times more than other clinics. One of my cats died after being admitted there, and the last time they hurt my kitten quite a bit when they put the IV in and drew blood (in her neck). They diagnosed her with cancer even though she suffers from epilepsy (and I took her in for a seizure) and they wanted to do several highly specialized tests. In the end, I took her to her own vet, and she doesn't have cancer or anything to suggest it, and they even prescribed completely wrong medications and dosages for her condition. The veterinarians have no idea what they're doing.

I urgently need to find a good and reliable emergency hospital, because this place is rubbish.

Terrible experience. My kitten was hospitalized twice for respiratory failure, under the pretext that he was aggressive. They practically never did anything for him, and the last time they returned him to me in terrible condition. The ward where they are hospitalized is dirty and neglected. Their lack of empathy, attention, and care led to my kitten's death, and the costs were exorbitant.

A few years ago, I took my puppy to this clinic for a parvovirus emergency. At the time, I trusted she would receive proper care, but she was met with disdain and almost indifference.

Sadly, my puppy passed away. Later, a necropsy performed by a trusted veterinarian—because of course I sought one out—indicated that she had suffered from severe dehydration and that her IV fluids had been improperly administered during her treatment.
Back then, there wasn't the amount of information and reviews that exists today, and as an owner, it was a very painful and frustrating experience.
Over time, reading other reviews of the same place, I see that this isn't an isolated case: there are patterns of complaints about the quality of service in relation to high costs.

I fully understand that veterinary services have a cost, and I've never expected them to be cheap. But it's one thing to pay for professional care and quite another to receive substandard service at the expense of a delicate moment. I'm sharing this because today there are tools to get informed, and I think it's important that other owners can make decisions with more context.

My dog ​​was hospitalized for several days with vomiting and diarrhea and was discharged in stable condition. Hours later, she worsened again; I contacted the clinic to report it, and they told me it was "normal."

Because of this, I decided to seek a second opinion, where she was diagnosed with pancreatitis and had to be hospitalized again.

After several days of treatment, I'm concerned that it wasn't detected or addressed in time. Furthermore, I requested the test results and haven't received a response.

I'm sharing this because, as an owner, one expects greater clarity, follow-up, and communication in a case like this.

Excellent experience.

I took my kitten (whom I rescued with a terrible eye) to Dr. Aytzeé Piñón (veterinary ophthalmologist) for an ophthalmology consultation, and she saved his eye in 4 weeks.

I'm sharing before and after photos.

Eternally grateful ❤️

About a year ago, I took my dog ​​to this veterinary hospital seeking help in an urgent situation. Unfortunately, my experience was very negative.

My pet needed a blood transfusion. After much effort, I managed to find a dog donor who met all the requirements. However, they refused to accept him simply because the owner asked to bring his pet inside, as the dog remained calm in his presence. I consider this refusal to be insensitive and inflexible in such a critical situation.

Furthermore, the staff was rude and unprofessional. Instead of providing support during such a delicate moment, they only added to my dog's stress.

I was also concerned that they intended to draw a considerable amount of blood from the donor when my dog ​​needed very little, which seemed excessive.

On top of that, the lab results took far too long to come back, and the information provided was very basic, despite the high costs.

I didn't write this review earlier because it was a very painful process after the loss of my dog, but I feel it's important to share my experience so that other pet owners can take it into account.
They are abusive with their prices.
Excellent service
They lost my biopsy results and aren't answering WhatsApp messages. It's a shame because Dr. Jorge is an incredible professional, but the operational aspects are terrible.

I took my dog ​​in for emergency surgery at night, and from the very first moment we were seen quickly. The care is efficient, and during her hospital stay, someone is always looking after her. The follow-up is excellent.

The professionals who care for our pets are experts, and the care is excellent and of high quality.

Thank you for bringing health to our family members 🦁
Excellent service.

From my first contact by phone to my in-person visit, all the staff are incredibly professional and super kind to both pet owners and, of course, their four-legged patients. If I could give them more than 5 stars, I would without hesitation. Thank you so much for your professionalism and for taking such good care of my dog! ✨🫶🏼
Kind, efficient, and empathetic
Everything was excellent, very friendly and fast.
My thanks to the medical and administrative team. All the doctors are EXCELLENT PROFESSIONALS! A superb service.
Excellent service and attention

I took my dog ​​in for some abscesses that appeared on her mammary glands. Dr. Luis examined her thoroughly and carefully. They ordered ultrasounds, X-rays, electrocardiograms, etc., and gave us options for scheduling them since the hospital's schedule is busy. While it's not cheap, the care we've received has been excellent from everyone.

Never take your pets to this vet. They killed my beloved puppy. She came in because she was drooling a lot, and they only gave her medication, saying she didn't need to be hospitalized, for less than two hours. We took her back to the emergency room because she started bleeding. She was hospitalized, and the next day we saw her looking better. An hour later, they told us my puppy had died. She could have been treated in time, but they misdiagnosed her. We thought she was poisoned, but they told us it was her pancreas. It was completely different. It's a shame that they profit from the pain we feel for our pets and that we're willing to pay whatever it takes for them to be well, only to be focused on running up a huge bill and ultimately not helping our animals.

The service is good, but honestly, if you don't have enough money, they'll rip you off. Just the three hours my dog ​​was there cost $4200, and the night I went back because they couldn't do anything for her cost another $4200. When they give you the bill, they don't explain the charges properly, and when you see them, they don't know how to explain them. They even charge you for moving her to the other side. The place is nice, but they don't justify their prices.
They've offered excellent service for years, with a good number of specialists. In my experience, it's been one of the best. Just one thing: specialist consultations only accept cash.

A few years ago, I used to take my dog ​​to that hospital, but unfortunately, it's not what it used to be. The service was extremely slow, and the examination left much to be desired. I don't know if it was due to the doctor's poor communication or because he was admitted through the emergency room, but I wouldn't take my little one there again, especially since the doctors aren't empathetic (I'm not asking for a discount, just that they understand how hard it is to see your dog sick).

Note: the doctor prescribed medication without considering my dog's health. My dog ​​was only two months old and had tested positive for canine coronavirus (he was a puppy rescued from an irresponsible breeder :(()).

There are some pretty shady and strange things going on with their diagnoses and treatments.

While Animal Home tells me my dog ​​has ehrlichiosis, other clinics and veterinarians tell me this is impossible because if it were true, my pet would have died 15 years ago, not been "incubated and dormant" all this time. Furthermore, the nighttime appointments are very welcome; they see you and charge you on the spot, but when it comes to providing information about your pet's condition, they casually tell you no, they don't give reports at night. Oh well, then I'll pay them Monday morning when it's a business day, right? The pharmacy is another story. Look, every business can charge what it wants, but tripling the price of a pill seems immoral, unethical, and shows unbridled greed. I took my dog ​​there because it came highly recommended, but even the person who recommended it was disappointed, especially after their dog was returned almost dead a few days ago. They washed their hands of it, gave her a "guarded diagnosis," and then strangely, she recovered in three days at home just by drinking water. O_o Weird, weird, weird. Also, another thing: the lab where they send the chemical tests (EXPERTO SUR) has a huge number of complaints and bad reviews on social media. I don't know, I think I should approach Animal Home Coapa with extreme caution and suspicion.

100% recommended. I had read bad reviews of the place, so I had never visited it before. However, due to an emergency with my Shih Tzu (her eye popped out) on New Year's Eve, we went here. It was one of the few places open on December 31st at 10:30 pm. They managed to save her very quickly, even though she lost her eye. The truth is, the care was fast and efficient, and her recovery was excellent. A month later, this same dog was attacked by a pit bull. She was badly bitten and in a lot of pain, and even with the other incident so recent, they saved her. They treated her very well and knew how to administer what she needed to recover. It was worth the money spent because they have a very warm and knowledgeable approach. Without a doubt, I would now entrust any of my dogs to them. ❤️ My whole family is grateful for the care we received.
My Maltese dog, Luna, has been treated there since she was 2 years old, and Dr. Andrea has helped her in very difficult cases; it's a good place.
They've provided my dog ​​with the best care since his illness, and he's recovering exactly as his vet said. They're very serious and professional; I truly recommend them.

Excellent service, everyone was friendly, and they were quick and responsive.

And they were very caring with the young patients.

We took our pug to the emergency vet because she had vomited a lot. We arrived around 8:20 PM and the wait was quite long, about an hour and a half or a little more. The consultation seemed good; the vet who saw us was professional and kind. They had X-ray equipment to check for pancreatitis or an intestinal obstruction. They prescribed medication, and she recovered very well.

The costs are perhaps high, but as pet owners, we have to be aware that emergencies are like that, and our pets are part of the family. To ensure they get better and are well, we have to be prepared and save up.
